title: The Unidentified Signal That Repeated the Same Prime Number for 72 Hours
hook: In 1995, a radio telescope picked up a signal that counted primes—then stopped forever when astronomers tried to trace it.
why_this_can_go_viral: The prime number sequence is the classic 'intelligent origin' marker; its sudden silence suggests something ominous.

title: The Black Hole That Ejects Stars Like Bullets
hook: A supermassive black hole is flinging stars across the galaxy at 4 million miles per hour—one is aimed at Earth.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines an active stellar danger with visceral imagery of 'bullets' and direct Earth threat.

title: The Classified Project That Found a Structure Inside the Moon
hook: Declassified Apollo mission transcripts reveal astronauts reported a 'monolith' that reflected unnatural light back to Earth.
why_this_can_go_viral: Taps into the enduring conspiracy of alien structures on the Moon, with real declassified transcripts as bait.

title: The Gamma Ray Burst That Dressed the Sky in Ghostly Blue
hook: A gamma ray burst hit Earth in 2014, so bright it blinded satellites—and left the sky glowing cyan for three nights.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visual spectacle of a changed sky combined with a real near-extinction event creates urgent fascination.

title: The Dark Matter Halo That Whispered in a Dead Galaxy
hook: Astronomers detected a faint signal from a galaxy where all stars died—the only source was dark matter itself.
why_this_can_go_viral: Dark matter 'speaking' from a dead galaxy is a haunting cosmic ghost story with scientific backing.

title: The Venus Probe That Photographed a City Before It Died
hook: A Soviet probe transmitted an image of grid-like structures on Venus seconds before the surface crushed it.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'lost city on Venus' trope is magnetic, especially with the dramatic probe destruction story.

title: The Rogue Planet That Carries the Remains of a Civilization
hook: A planet ejected from its star system has a surface covered in radioactive isotopes—evidence of a nuclear apocalypse.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines the Fermi Paradox with a concrete, terrifying artifact of alien self-destruction.

title: The Secret Space Force Mission That Retrieved an Object from Orbit
hook: A classified Space Force mission brought down an unidentified object from orbit—and the crew was quarantined for a year.
why_this_can_go_viral: Government secrecy + orbital retrieval + quarantined crew = irresistible mystery and conspiracy fuel.

title: The Comet That Released a Cloud of Cyanide Gas Over Earth
hook: In 1910, Earth passed through the tail of Halley's Comet, which was laced with cyanide—millions panicked and bought 'comet pills.'
why_this_can_go_viral: Historical mass hysteria + actual poison in the sky = perfect blend of fear and weird human behavior.

title: The Star That Pulses with the Rhythm of a Heartbeat
hook: A star 7,000 light-years away pulses exactly like a human heart—and the pattern is accelerating toward a stop.
why_this_can_go_viral: Anthropomorphic pattern recognition + impending cosmic death makes for a haunting, shareable concept.

title: The Satellite That Detected a Gravity Ripple from the Void Between Galaxies
hook: A gravitational wave came from a region of empty space with no black holes, no stars—just pure nothing.
why_this_can_go_viral: A signal from pure nothing challenges physics and feels like a cosmic horror story.

title: The Extinction Event That Left a Global Layer of Soot—and No Known Cause
hook: A thin layer of soot from 12,800 years ago covers the entire planet, but no volcano, asteroid, or fire explains it.
why_this_can_go_viral: A global catastrophe with no explanation triggers deep curiosity and apocalyptic dread.

title: The Radio Signal That Was a Mirror Image of Earth's Own Broadcasts
hook: Astronomers picked up a signal that perfectly mirrored a 1960s Earth TV broadcast—from a star system 40 light-years away.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of an alien civilization watching our old broadcasts back to us is eerie and mind-bending.

title: The Stellar Flare That Triggered a Global Blackout in 1859—Classified
hook: The Carrington Event was so powerful it set telegraph wires on fire—but governments hid the full extent of the damage.
why_this_can_go_viral: Historical disaster + government cover-up angle makes a familiar event feel new and dangerous.

title: The Fermi Paradox Filter That Is a Galactic Mind-Wiping Event
hook: Every few million years, a wave of energy sweeps the galaxy, erasing all memory of advanced civilizations.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines the Fermi Paradox with a terrifying periodic purge, playing on fears of forgotten pasts.

title: The Dark Matter Particle That Absorbs Light in a Distant Galaxy
hook: A galaxy is slowly dimming because dark matter is literally drinking its starlight, turning it into a shadow.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visual imagery of a galaxy being 'eaten' by darkness is poetic and unsettling.

title: The Classified ESA Recording of a Planet That Screamed
hook: ESA sensors recorded an audio waveform from a gas giant—it sounded exactly like a terrified human scream.
why_this_can_go_viral: The visceral horror of a planet screaming taps into primal fear; classified angle adds conspiracy weight.

title: The Asteroid That Had a Hollow Interior—and Something Inside Rattled
hook: Radar imaging revealed an asteroid is hollow, and the echoes suggested a dense object moving inside its cavity.
why_this_can_go_viral: A hollow asteroid with something moving inside is pure science fiction become reality.

title: The Comet That Left a Trail of Antimatter
hook: A comet's tail emitted gamma rays that could only come from matter-antimatter annihilation—something in it was made of opposite stuff.
why_this_can_go_viral: Antimatter in a comet is a rare and explosive anomaly that feels like a cosmic danger.

title: The Signal That Was a Dying Civilization's Final SOS
hook: A repeating radio signal slowly degraded over 20 years into noise—the last words of a species light-years away.
why_this_can_go_viral: A slow-motion alien extinction story broadcast across space is deeply tragic and shareable.

title: The Stellar Flare That Was a Controlled Detonation of a Star's Core
hook: A star exploded with perfect spherical symmetry—something impossible in nature, suggesting an artificial trigger.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of a star being used as a weapon or energy source by an advanced civilization is awe-inspiring and scary.

title: The Rogue Planet That Has a Solid Diamond Core the Size of Earth
hook: A ejected planet has a core of compressed diamond—and it's drifting toward our system with a gravitational whisper.
why_this_can_go_viral: The allure of a diamond planet combined with a stealthy approach toward Earth makes it clickable and ominous.
